# Column reference

Every column mofsift writes, grouped by the stage that writes it. The same dictionary
travels with every bundle, in the `columns` section of its `manifest.json`.

- An empty cell (CSV) or `null` (JSON) means the value was not computed. It never means
  zero.
- Each stage also writes `<stage>_status` (`ok`, `skipped` or `failed`) and
  `<stage>_skip_reason`.
- Columns of your own table are kept and exported; they are not listed here.

## generate

Guide: [generate-and-qc.md](generate-and-qc.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | | Record ID; the key of the table. It depends only on what defines the candidate. |
| `name` | string |  | Readable label: topology__nodes__edges, or the file name. |
| `source` | string |  | Where the structure comes from: pormake or cifs. |
| `topology` | string |  | Net the structure was assembled on; empty for existing CIFs. |
| `nodes` | string |  | Node building blocks, + between several. |
| `edges` | string |  | Edge building blocks, + between several; empty without edges. |
| `source_file` | string |  | Original file inside cif_dir; empty for assembled structures. |
| `n_atoms` | integer |  | Atoms in the unit cell. |
| `formula` | string |  | Formula of the unit cell, Hill order. |
| `expected_formula` | string |  | Sum of the building blocks; empty for existing CIFs. |
| `linker_smiles` | string |  | Canonical SMILES of the linkers when they are known, ; between several. |
| `node_rmsd` | number | angstrom | Largest node-to-vertex misfit reported by PORMAKE. |
| `cif_path` | string |  | Path of the structure file, relative to the folder that holds the table. |
| `generate_status` | string |  | Whether the structure was built or read: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `generate_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## qc

Guide: [generate-and-qc.md](generate-and-qc.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `density` | number | g/cm3 | Density from the cell and the atomic masses. |
| `volume` | number | angstrom3 | Cell volume. |
| `cell_a` | number | angstrom | Cell length a. |
| `cell_b` | number | angstrom | Cell length b. |
| `cell_c` | number | angstrom | Cell length c. |
| `cell_alpha` | number | degree | Cell angle alpha. |
| `cell_beta` | number | degree | Cell angle beta. |
| `cell_gamma` | number | degree | Cell angle gamma. |
| `qc_min_distance` | number | angstrom | Shortest interatomic distance. |
| `qc_n_close_pairs` | integer |  | Pairs of atoms closer than qc.min_distance. |
| `qc_n_overlaps` | integer |  | Heavy-heavy or H-H pairs closer than qc.min_distance_heavy. |
| `qc_n_nonbonded_contacts` | integer |  | Non-bonded pairs closer than allowed. |
| `qc_n_components` | integer |  | Connected components of the bond network. |
| `qc_n_isolated_atoms` | integer |  | Atoms without any bond. |
| `qc_n_bad_h` | integer |  | H atoms that do not have exactly one neighbour. |
| `qc_n_bad_c` | integer |  | C atoms with fewer than 2 or more than 4 non-metal neighbours. |
| `qc_n_short_bonds` | integer |  | Compressed covalent bonds (reported, not a check). |
| `qc_composition_ok` | boolean |  | The formula equals the sum of the building blocks. |
| `qc_node_rmsd_ok` | boolean |  | The node misfit is within qc.max_node_rmsd. |
| `qc_pass` | boolean |  | No enabled structural check failed. Not a statement about stability or synthesis. |
| `qc_reasons` | string |  | The failed checks, separated by ; . |
| `qc_status` | string |  | Whether the checks ran: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `qc_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## describe: composition

Guide: [describe.md](describe.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `primary_metal` | string |  | Most abundant metal (ties: alphabetical). |
| `metals` | string |  | All metals present, + between them. |
| `n_metal_atoms` | integer |  | Metal atoms in the unit cell. |
| `metal_fraction` | number |  | Metal atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `n_transition_metal_atoms` | integer |  | d-block atoms in the unit cell. |
| `has_open_shell_3d_metal` | boolean |  | The primary metal is Ti-Cu. A flag on the composition, not a computed spin state. |
| `c_fraction` | number |  | C atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `h_fraction` | number |  | H atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `n_fraction` | number |  | N atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `o_fraction` | number |  | O atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `heteroatom_fraction` | number |  | N, O, S, F, Cl, Br and I atoms as a fraction of all atoms. |
| `mean_atomic_number` | number |  | Mean atomic number over all atoms. |
| `std_atomic_number` | number |  | Spread of the atomic number over all atoms. |
| `mean_electronegativity` | number |  | Mean Pauling electronegativity over all atoms. |
| `std_electronegativity` | number |  | Spread of the Pauling electronegativity over all atoms. |
| `describe_composition_status` | string |  | Whether the composition descriptors were computed: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `describe_composition_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## describe: pore geometry (Zeo++)

Guide: [describe.md](describe.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zeo_high_accuracy` | string |  | Zeo++ accuracy setting that produced this row: OCC, DEF or off. |
| `lcd` | number | angstrom | Largest cavity diameter (largest included sphere). |
| `pld` | number | angstrom | Pore limiting diameter (largest free sphere). |
| `lcd_free_path` | number | angstrom | Largest included sphere along the free-sphere path. |
| `accessible_surface_m2_g` | number | m2/g | Surface accessible to the probe. |
| `accessible_surface_m2_cm3` | number | m2/cm3 | Surface accessible to the probe. |
| `accessible_volume_fraction` | number |  | Fraction of the cell volume accessible to the centre of the probe. |
| `accessible_volume_cm3_g` | number | cm3/g | Volume accessible to the centre of the probe. |
| `describe_geometry_status` | string |  | Whether the pore geometry was computed: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `describe_geometry_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## describe: xTB

Guide: [describe.md](describe.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `xtb_gap` | number | eV | xtb_lumo minus xtb_homo from periodic GFN-xTB. A proxy, not a DFT or measured band gap; comparable between rows only when xtb_unpaired_electrons is 0. |
| `xtb_homo` | number | eV | Highest doubly occupied level. |
| `xtb_lumo` | number | eV | Lowest level that is not doubly occupied. |
| `xtb_unpaired_electrons` | integer |  | Unpaired electrons used in the calculation (a rule of thumb, not computed). |
| `describe_xtb_status` | string |  | Whether the xTB calculation ran: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `describe_xtb_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## score

Guide: [score.md](score.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `linker_sa` | number |  | SA score of the linker, 1 (easy) to 10 (hard). Smaller is better. |
| `linker_sc` | number |  | SCScore of the linker, 1 (simple) to 5 (complex). Smaller is better. |
| `linker_size` | integer |  | Heavy atoms of the linker. Smaller is better. |
| `linker_rotatable_bonds` | integer |  | Rotatable bonds of the linker. Smaller is better. |
| `precedent_topology` | integer |  | Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this topology. Larger is better. |
| `precedent_node` | integer |  | Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this primary metal. Information only: it does not separate synthesised from hypothetical MOFs. |
| `precedent_linker` | integer |  | Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker. Larger is better. |
| `precedent_pair` | integer |  | Distinct synthesised MOFs in the reference with this linker and metal. Larger is better. |
| `score_aggregate` | number |  | Weighted mean rank of the chosen components within one table, 0 (worst) to 1 (best). Not a probability, and not comparable between tables. |
| `score_notes` | string |  | Why a component is empty for this row. |
| `score_status` | string |  | Whether at least one component was computed: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `score_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |

## filter

Guide: [export.md](export.md).

| Column | Type | Unit | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filter_pass` | boolean |  | The row satisfies every filter of the config. Empty when there are no filters. |
| `filter_rejected_by` | string |  | The filters the row did not satisfy, with the missing columns when undecided. |
| `filter_status` | string |  | Whether the filters were applied: ok, skipped or failed. |
| `filter_skip_reason` | string |  | Why, when the status is not ok. |
